title: WriteAccess::Checking/Allowing has no lost-request sweep (emoji Granting, phone and data sends do)
trigger: A mini app calls web_app_request_write_access; canBotSendMessages/allowBotToSendMessages leaves flight with no answer (stale sweep or reconnect)
effect: The app never hears write_access_requested and every later request gets 'false' (busy) until the mini app window is closed
fix: Add the same requests.get(request).is_none() check in poll_emoji_status style, ending Checking/Allowing with a false reply

title: Widget runtime thread is not panic-guarded; a panic leaves the entry in Loading/Running forever
trigger: A widget's display list or font/canvas code panics on the quill-widget thread (thread::run is a bare std::thread, only FFI callbacks are guarded)
effect: The thread ends silently, no Failed/Stopped event is sent, inbox sends are dropped; the bubble keeps the placeholder or last frame (looks live, never responds) until the widget is shed or replaced
fix: Spawn with thread_guard::spawn_guarded and publish RuntimeEvent::Failed when the thread ends without Inbox::Stop

title: Player::presenting (AwaitingFirst) and Clock's HeldAfterSeek are one stage held in two values kept in step by hand
trigger: Seek: Player::seek sets Presenting::AwaitingFirst and Clock::seek holds; release happens in take_frame_for, update_ended and step_forward separately
effect: No bug today; a new seek/step path that updates one and not the other leaves the clock held with no picture coming (position frozen)
fix: Fold the first-picture hold into Presenting (or into Clock) so one value moves both

title: MiniAppWindow::theme is a snapshot taken at launch and never refreshed; theme_changed is never sent
trigger: Open a mini app, then switch light/dark/high-contrast (or auto-night flips)
effect: The mini app keeps the old colours until it is closed and reopened
fix: Send HostCommand theme + BridgeReply::theme_changed from a theme observer, or hold the theme in the app and read it per send

title: Self-update availability is probed once per process (OnceLock) and never re-probed
trigger: Start Quill from a read-only or foreign folder, then make it writable (or move the install) without restarting
effect: Settings keeps saying the copy cannot update itself until restart
fix: Re-probe on Settings open / after a failed stage, or store the probe with a timestamp

title: tcp() resolves the tunnel host with a blocking to_socket_addrs that ignores Cancel and the ceremony deadline
trigger: Start a phone passkey ceremony on a network with a hanging DNS resolver, then press Cancel
effect: The dialog closes but the worker thread stays in DNS until the OS resolver gives up
fix: Resolve on a helper thread polled against Stop, or bound the lookup
